facts.text: Shepherd University requires a multi-tier Core Curriculum for all bachelor's degrees, with the exception of the Regents B.A. degree.

sources.title: Program: Core Curriculum - Shepherd University
sources.quote: Shepherd University has established the following Core Curriculum which is required for all bachelor's degrees except the Regents B.A. degree, which has a separate set of requirements found under that section of the Catalog.
